note: Spec 582 S1: five fixed poses for tools/measure_horizon.sh. Four stand 24 m up (a tower or ridge, as the existing bench and edge poses do) and are gated; the fifth stands at eye height and is recorded without a gate, so the report says plainly what a walker at ground level sees. cam is [x, z] in metres; the camera stands at the engine's ground height there plus height_m; heading_deg is compass-style (0 toward +z, 90 toward +x); horizon_frac is where the horizon line sits in the frame (0 top, 1 bottom).
